BEFORE: clean upstream 94f4e0a6e9f8
Real browser keyboard input and real HTTP MCP. Synthetic page.

Type a sentence in the browser.
HTTP MCP confirms it; the agent reads this CURRENT body and revision.

MCP changes only Status, supplying the matching baseRevision.
Both changes are present. No stale write, injected lock or acceptance delay.

BEFORE: press Ctrl+Z. The browser sentence stays.
A normal API update has destroyed its useful Undo history.

Ctrl+Y leaves the same text; Ctrl+Z did not undo the sentence.
The API request succeeded, but local editing history was lost.

Reload, browser and REST/MCP readbacks agree.
The difference is whether your own sentence can be undone after the API edit.
